# proxmox_node_vzdump (Resource)

Starts a `vzdump` backup of one guest through `POST /nodes/{node}/vzdump` and waits for the worker. The action is imperative: every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_vzdump" "nightly" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  vmid     = 300
  storage  = "backup"
  mode     = "snapshot"
  compress = "zstd"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node. Changes require replacement.
- `storage` (String) Backup storage. Changes require replacement.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to back up again.
- `vmid` (Number) Guest VMID to back up. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `compress` (String) Compression: `0`, `1`, `gzip`, `lzo`, `zstd`.
- `mode` (String) Backup mode: `snapshot`, `suspend` or `stop`.
- `notes_template` (String) Template for the backup notes.
- `protected` (Boolean) Mark the backup as protected.
- `quiet` (Boolean) Suppress progress output.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<vmid>` form.
- `upid` (String) Worker task UPID.
